description.p: Vellum is a clean, focused text editor built with GTK4, Libadwaita and GtkSourceView.
It supports multiple documents, syntax highlighting, search and replace, local draft recovery, and C plugins.
Fix AI inline completion ghost text not disappearing on accept or reject.
Restrict automatic AI completion to code documents to avoid chat-like suggestions.
Make auto-pair brackets work in both normal and Vi insert mode, with a new preference toggle.
Add Vi mode yy (yank line), cc (change line) and p (paste).
Clean up draft snapshots on discard, snapshot on exit, and skip empty drafts.
Unify the application display name as vellum in all languages.
Allow removing built-in extensions from the Extensions window, with removal persisted across restarts.
Add a welcome guide plugin that introduces the editor and asks to remove itself after the tour.
Guard AI completion requests with lifecycle generations and make inline candidate overlays follow their owning document safely across tab switches and document destruction.

Add a restartable core-only mode that loads no extensions, stabilize automatic local Markdown Mode detection against hidden markup, and include a restricted TUI GTK debugging helper for repeatable regression checks.
Refine external-file change notifications into a two-line banner below the header bar.
Add editable persistent shortcuts, zoom reset, automatic local Markdown Mode, and a 50%-opacity inline AI completion candidate accepted with Tab or dismissed with Escape.
Add safe external-file change notifications with discard-and-reload, a Vi-compatible command prompt, a standalone Build & Run tool window, lifecycle guards, and an original Vellum application icon.
Replace document saving with a standard GIO asynchronous replace operation so file-system writes no longer block the editor interface.
Add save-in-progress protection and visible save status, including a regression test for the actual window save action.
Add an independent visual code-theme chooser with live GtkSourceView C syntax previews and persistent selection.
Escape extension metadata before rendering it as Adwaita markup, fixing Build & Run settings warnings; make extension controls compact icon actions with tooltips.
Add validated .vut ZIP extension packages and ship all built-in extensions as auditable source packages that can be rebuilt for the local Linux architecture.
Add persistent extension enable switches, Project Sidebar, Build & Run, Markdown Preview, Vim Mode, an overview map, editor display and indentation preferences, and a keyboard shortcut reference.
Add configurable real-tab display widths, live content-aware language recognition, and heuristic red error underlines for unbalanced brackets and quotes.
Add the manual Test Links extension, make saved OpenAI-compatible /v1 addresses work for AI Completion, and ship the project under BSD-2-Clause after a source and asset audit.
Rework the dark editor surface around Libadwaita and GtkSourceView Adwaita-dark, add extension import/export/removal/configuration, and add a user-configured AI completion extension.
Add explicit English and Simplified Chinese language packs, custom editor fonts, enhanced dark source themes, content-aware language recognition, and extension management.
